findings.reason: The new per-record shape check runs before the existing `$schemaVersion > WORKSPACES_SCHEMA_VERSION` check (line 474). If a newer claude4spec writes a registry whose records have a different shape, an older binary now says `workspaces[i] is not a workspace record` (which reads as a damaged file) when it should say `schema version N not supported by this claude4spec version` (which tells the user to upgrade). Both end up as REGISTRY_READ_FAILED, so no test catches it, but the downgrade message is lost. Fix: move the record validation below the schema-version guard.

This is the only client test in the repo that imports server modules (`../../server/workspace/registry.js`, `spa-route.js`) and uses node `fs` in a happy-dom environment. The server half of the claim (route resolution after a hand-edited cwd still yields the stored id) is a server concern and is already the pattern of `src/server/workspace/spa-route.test.ts`. The client test could inject the id directly and leave the registry round-trip to a server test. It works as written, but it blurs the client/server test boundary.
